prompt_provenance.note: Built on 2026-06-11 in a Claude Code session at ~/Desktop/python/dota-analyst, whose transcript no longer exists (transcripts older than 30 days are cleaned up). The request is known only from the design document it implemented, quoted in evidence.

evidence: Commit d1f4f63 (2026-06-11, 'Build v1 of the stratz-analysis Claude Agent Skill') added the script as 'end-to-end validation'.

DESIGN.md at d1f4f63, build order step 3 (a planning document, not a user prompt): 'Run one end-to-end analysis (e.g., weekly hero win rates by bracket) to validate the loop; harvest the first cookbook.md entries from it.'

interpreted_question.text: For each rank, which heroes had the highest win rate in the latest complete week, and do Stratz's weekly hero stats pass the 50% win-rate sanity check?
interpreted_question.provenance: Inferred from the design document and the script.

implemented_scope.source: heroStats.winWeek, one query per rank (RankBracket HERALD..IMMORTAL), last 8 weeks, ALL_PICK_RANKED; constants.heroes for names
implemented_scope.period: the latest complete week: a week starting at T counts as complete once now >= T + 7 days
implemented_scope.rows: top 5 heroes by win rate per rank

methodological_choices: Win rate = winCount / matchCount; matchCount counts picks (10 per match), not matches.
Sanity check: the pick-weighted mean win rate per rank must be 0.5.
No position filter: every position is pooled.

rerun.requirements: STRATZ_TOKEN in .env; network access to api.stratz.com (responses cached in data/raw/ for 7 days).
rerun.repeatability_note: 'Latest complete week' is a dynamic default: a rerun more than 7 days after a recorded run fetches newer weeks and gives different numbers. The dated report is the lasting record.

runs.note: Original validation run; no report was saved.

runs.code_revision: e60e03d plus the uncommitted move to analyses/weekly_winrates_by_bracket/ (paths only)
runs.resolved_period: week starting 2026-09-10 (Stratz weeks start on Thursday)
runs.data_note: Stratz's hero stats stopped at 2026-09-17 on this date (about 12 days behind), so the latest complete week was 2026-09-10 to 09-16.
runs.top: Wraith King tops Guardian, Crusader and Archon; Bounty Hunter tops Ancient and Immortal; Spectre tops Herald; Visage tops Legend; Meepo tops Divine
